{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "review_score",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "avg_word_length", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Stylistic feature of the review text, computable before knowing the score; weak but legitimate signal."},
    {"name": "capitalized_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Text-derived feature independent of the score; may capture emphasis/tone."},
    {"name": "exclamation_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Punctuation feature plausibly correlated with enthusiasm/rating; not a restatement of score."},
    {"name": "has_product_mention", "role": "irrelevant", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Almost entirely constant (9934 zeros vs 66 ones), so it carries essentially no discriminative signal."},
    {"name": "helpfulness_ratio", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Derived from helpfulness votes, external to the score; weak but plausible predictor and not leakage of the score itself."},
    {"name": "negative_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Lexicon-based sentiment count from text; genuinely predictive of rating and not a restatement of the numeric score."},
    {"name": "positive_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Positive sentiment lexicon count is a strong, legitimate predictor of review score."},
    {"name": "question_mark_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Punctuation feature from text; weak but valid predictive signal, not leakage."},
    {"name": "summary_length", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Length of summary text, knowable pre-outcome; weak stylistic predictor."},
    {"name": "text_length", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Review length is a legitimate feature that can correlate with rating extremity/verbosity."},
    {"name": "word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Token count of text; valid, though redundant with text_length, it remains a legitimate predictor."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 10,
  "predictive_utility": 0.55,
  "rationale": "None of the columns restate or leak the score, so this is a clean feature-engineering set. The sentiment lexicon counts (positive_word_count, negative_word_count) provide the strongest genuine predictive leverage for review score, and helpfulness_ratio adds external signal. The remaining stylistic/punctuation/length features are legitimate but individually weak and partially redundant (text_length vs word_count vs summary_length). has_product_mention is near-constant and effectively useless. Overall the set gives moderate predictive leverage beyond the original columns, driven mainly by sentiment counts."
}
